camel_example: aliyun cloudauth DeepfakeDetect --region cn-hangzhou --FaceBase64 '/9j/4AAQSkZJRgABAQAASxxxxxxx' --FaceInputType IMAGE --OuterOrderNo e0c34a77f5ac40a5aa5e6ed20c000000 --FaceUrl 'https://cn-shanghai-aliyun-cloudauth-xxxxxx.oss-cn-shanghai.aliyuncs.com/verify/xxxxx/xxxxx.jpeg'
description_en: Accepts a face image and uses algorithms to detect deepfake risks. Covers risk scenarios such as AIGC-generated faces, deepfake face swaps, template faces, and recaptured faces. Returns risk labels and confidence levels
description_zh: 传入人脸图片，通过算法检测是否存在深度伪造风险。包含AIGC生成人脸、深度伪造换脸、模板人脸、翻拍人脸等风险场景，输出风险标签与置信度
kebab_example: aliyun cloudauth deepfake-detect --outer-order-no e0c34a77f5ac40a5aa5e6ed20c000000 --face-input-type IMAGE --face-url https://cn-shanghai-aliyun-cloudauth-xxxxxx.oss-cn-shanghai.aliyuncs.com/verify/xxxxx/xxxxx.jpeg --face-base64 /9j/4AAQSkZJRgABAQAASxxxxxxx --api-version 2019-03-07 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DeepfakeDetect

parameters.help_en: The unique identifier of the merchant request. The value is a 32-character alphanumeric string. The first few characters consist of a custom merchant abbreviation, the middle part can contain a time segment, and the last part can use a random or incremental sequence
parameters.help_zh: 商户请求的唯一标识，值为32位长度的字母数字组合。其中前几位字符由商户自定义的简称组成，中间部分可以包含一段时间，而后段可以采用随机或递增序列
parameters.name: outer_order_no

parameters.help_en:
The input type of the face material. Valid values:

IMAGE (default): face image
VIDEO: face video

Video processing takes longer. Set the timeout to more than 3 seconds
parameters.help_zh:
人脸素材输入类型：

IMAGE（默认）：人脸图片
VIDEO：人脸视频

视频处理时间较久，建议超时时间设置>3S
parameters.name: face_input_type

parameters.help_en:
The URL of the face image.
Specify either FaceUrl or FaceBase64
parameters.help_zh:
传入人脸图片URL地址。
FaceUrl和FaceBase64需选择传入其中一个
parameters.name: face_url

parameters.help_en:
The Base64-encoded face image.
Specify either FaceUrl or FaceBase64
parameters.help_zh:
传入人脸图片的Base64格式编码。
FaceUrl和FaceBase64需选择传入其中一个
parameters.name: face_base64

Code.description_en: The return code. A value of 200 indicates success. Other values indicate failure
Code.description_zh: 返回码：200为成功，其他为失败

Result.description_en:
The risk result. Valid values:

0: Low risk.
1: High risk.
2: Suspicious
Result.description_zh:
风险结果：

0：低风险
1：高风险
2：可疑

additionalProperties.description_en: 风险分值标签及其分值
additionalProperties.description_zh: 风险分值标签及其分值

RiskTag.description_en:
The risk labels. Multiple labels are separated by commas (,). Valid values:

SuspectDeepForgery: suspected deepfake
SuspectPSFace: suspected synthetic attack
SuspectTemple: suspected fraudulent attack
SuspectRemake: suspected recaptured face
RiskTag.description_zh:
风险标签。多个标签使用半角逗号（,）隔开，包括：

疑似深度伪造  SuspectDeepForgery
疑似合成攻击  SuspectPSFace
疑似黑产攻击  SuspectTemple
疑似翻拍人脸  SuspectRemake
